title: Reproducibility and Prognosis of Quantitative Features Extracted from CT Images

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Reproducibility and Prognosis of Quantitative Features Extracted from CT Images》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】We study the reproducibility of quantitative imaging features that are used to describe tumor shape, size, and texture from computed tomography (CT) scans of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

evidence.text: We study the reproducibility of quantitative imaging features that are used to describe tumor shape, size, and texture from computed tomography (CT) scans of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Reproducibility and Prognosis of Quantitative Features Extracted from CT Images》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】We focus on characterizing image features that are reproducible in the presence of variations due to patient factors and segmentation methods.

evidence.text: We focus on characterizing image features that are reproducible in the presence of variations due to patient factors and segmentation methods.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Reproducibility and Prognosis of Quantitative Features Extracted from CT Images》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】In this study, there were 29 features across segmentation methods found with CCCTreT and DR ≥ 0.9 and R(2) Bet ≥ 0.95.
